source.quote: Hass was the most precocious and consistent bearer, averaging over 15 t ha-1 and reaching an average of 20 t ha-1 by the sixth year. Thereafter, an average yield of about 22,5 t ha-1 appears to be sustainable.

yearsToFullBearing.note: In this irrigated, intensively managed Natal Midlands trial, Hass reached about 20 t/ha at age 6 and orchards approached maximum sustainable average yield by age 8. This is a trial-specific bearing reference; there is no national plateau or automatically interpolated age-yield curve.

source.quote: reaching an average of 20 t ha-1 by the sixth year. Thereafter, an average yield of about 22,5 t ha-1 appears to be sustainable ... At a spacing of 7 x 7 m (200 trees per ha)
source.doc: Wolstenholme, Kaiser & Palmer, SAAGA Yearbook 1991, 14:15-18

Intermediate ages are not inferred.

source.quote: Hass, an A-type flowerer, tended to be out of phase with Fuerte and Rinton on a seasonal yield basis ... favourable temperatures at fruit-set (especially in B flowering type cultivars such as Fuerte) can result in heavy cropping
source.doc: Wolstenholme, Kaiser & Palmer, SAAGA Yearbook 1991, 14:15-18

pollination.note: SA source confirms avocado's type A / type B protogynous dichogamous flowering system (temporal separation of male and female phases within a single tree) rather than stating self-fertility directly. supplementaryReferences.title: Hass age benchmarks — irrigated Natal Midlands trial

source.quote: 10 t ha-1 by year three
